files.html:
DRM Cobblemon Editor 0.1.0

  • Initial release.
  • Added custom trainer and Pokémon battles.
  • Added multi-round battles with conditions and rewards.
  • Added PokéMart sales, trades, and auctions.
  • Added a custom battle intro maker.
  • Added DRM editor integration and sample presets.
  • Added English and Korean language support.
